description: Produce a standard-library Python module that renders JSON records as a Markdown table, plus pytest tests. Choose this when JSON records must become a GitHub-flavoured Markdown table with pipes escaped. Do not choose this for HTML tables, spreadsheet formats, or column alignment rules beyond the template. Example requests: Write a Python module that renders JSON records as a GitHub Markdown table, with tests. | I need a Markdown table renderer that escapes pipes so data cannot break the table. | Generate a Markdown-table module and test it.
